notes.kicker: note - how these renders were produced
body: A widget-test harness (test/render/render_screen_test.dart); zero app code touched. It pumps the real GenericProfilePage after calling this shell's own registerSupachargeProfileSections() - the same function main.dart's generated di-hooks block calls at boot - renders it at 390 logical px (dpr 3) at the page's full content height, and captures the RepaintBoundary to PNG.

The data is the SDKs' own demo data, not fixtures written for this page. The test runs with --dart-define=IS_DEMO=true and calls the SDKs' DI registrations in composed-app order, so LmsSdkDependencies installs DemoLmsRepository and SeededTutorCatalog and AuthSdkDependencies installs MockAuthRepository. The persona in the identity header is MockAuthRepository's own demo profile, persisted through the app's real LocalStorage.setUser.

Real, not simulated: Inter, Montserrat and Roboto loaded as real font files, the real MaterialIcons and Remix icon fonts, the app's own brand palette through applyAppBrandColors(), and AppStyle light/dark tokens resolved by the real setBrightness seam. Layout, spacing, typography, colour, registry order and visibility gates are all the shipped code path.

notes.kicker: what these frames deliberately do NOT show
body: Device history is NOT seeded. The attendance ledger and the library are stores a device accumulates through use - the schedule writes them as lessons are attended, and DemoLmsRepository.recordAttendanceEvent is a deliberate no-op - so a widget test starts with them empty. Seeding them through the real store API is the kit's documented exception; this first adoption takes the default path, so the attendance and per-topic cards show their genuine fresh-device state. That is a truthful frame, not a bug.

Two operator rows (Lesson review, Announcements, Homework queue) are visible because demo mode opens their server gates on purpose - the guided tour previews the admin surfaces. A production student never sees them.
The footer's backend probe and PackageInfo both fail headlessly, so the footer renders its real offline / unknown-version state.

notes.kicker: numbering - two keys per wrapped row, on purpose
body: LmsSchoolCard and LmsAppearanceCard each RETURN an LmsSettingCard, so the section-id finder and the generic settings-row finder match the same rectangle and the harness's de-duplication keeps exactly one of them. The map carries a number for both spellings (3/4 for the school row, 19/20 for the appearance row) so the page numbers correctly whichever survives, and neither number is ever re-issued for anything else.
